pages.text: Frequencies 1-5000 are shared by the whole world, across dimensions and unloaded chunks. Right-click to set the frequency.$(br2)A powered $(item)Transmitter$() broadcasts; a $(item)Receiver$() outputs 15 on every side while its frequency is active.
The $(item)Wireless Remote$() transmits while you hold right-click; Shift-right-click sets its frequency.
